outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image spacing, not a plot.
Panel c shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating insets/zoom, not a plot.
Panel d shows a series of grayscale micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color swatches, micrographs and a stained photograph illustrating channel annotation, not a plot.
Panel f shows schematic overlap diagrams and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel separation, not a plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
